jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Industrial Hygienist
jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we're building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we're creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you'll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.  

  

Fueled by high\-quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest\-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry\-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.  

  

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high\-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

 **Environmental Scientist/Industrial Hygienist**


*Locations: Los Angeles or Orange County \| \~50% field / 50% remote*



Apex is seeking an environmental professional with experience in industrial hygiene to perform asbestos, lead\-paint, mold/moisture intrusion, exposure assessment, abatement monitoring, and related industrial hygiene and EHS compliance projects across Southern California.

  

**Employee Benefits**  

This role offers competitive compensation and a robust benefits package, a balanced mix of fieldwork and report writing, company sponsorship for professional and vocational training, work from home opportunity, collaboration with other industrial hygiene, EHS and other experts, and continued professional development and growth afforded by a rapidly growing national environmental consulting company.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Perform asbestos, lead\-based paint (LBP), and microbial/moisture intrusion assessments, along with abatement oversight, with an approximate 50/50 split between field and office work
* Conduct safety and compliance assessments in accordance with regulatory standards and client requirements
* Support additional environmental services through cross\-training, including:
	+ Exposure assessments
	+ Workplace safety evaluations
	+ Stormwater compliance inspections
	+ Soil and groundwater sampling
	+ Noise and air monitoring
	+ Aboveground Storage Tank (AST) inspections
* Execute work in alignment with project work plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and direction from project managers
* Manage scheduling and logistics across all project phases, from coordination and fieldwork through reporting
* Prepare clear, accurate, and technically sound client\-ready reports using project\-specific templates
* Collaborate with internal teams to support project delivery and ongoing professional development
* Maintain and proactively pursue relevant certifications, including 40\-Hour HAZWOPER, CAC, and/or CSST


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of professional experience conducting asbestos surveys and mold/moisture intrusion inspections as an AHERA\-accredited inspector (in any state)
* Current AHERA certification required
* California Certified Asbestos Consultant (CAC) and/or Certified Site Surveillance Technician (CSST) preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Microbiology, or a related field


**What We're Looking For**


* Self\-motivated and dependable professional who can work effectively with limited supervision
* Strong technical writing and critical thinking skills
* Solid analytical and math skills for interpreting laboratory data and preparing reports
* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate in a team\-oriented environment
* Physically capable of performing fieldwork and comfortable working in both field and office settings
* Commitment to safety and a strong understanding of safe work practices
* Interest in growing within industrial hygiene and expanding into broader environmental consulting services


**Why you'll love working for us:**


* Company\-subsidized medical and dental.
* Company\-paid life, short, and long\-term disability.
* 401k match, tuition assistance, and more.
* Cross\-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
* Performance\-based bonuses or other incentives.
* Working with the best and brightest in the industry.
* 2,000\+ employee national firm with 70\+ locations across the US.

jobs.title: Environmental Geologist 04231 NWP
jobs.description:
**Location: Simi Valley, California**  

**Title: Environmental Geologist**  

**Schedule (FT/PT): Regular Full Time**  

**Travel Required: No**  

**Government Clearance: Ability to Obtain**


As a nationally recognized and awarded small, disadvantaged business with over 30 years of successful experience, North Wind Portage, Inc. is committed to solving our clients' most challenging environmental issues and creating and sustaining a better environment. Dedicated to developing strong partnerships with our clients and stakeholders, mixing innovation with proven strategies, and developing and inspiring our staff, North Wind Portage delivers exceptional customer service, quality services, and safe and reliable project completion. Ranging from $5,000 to over $6\.4 billion, our projects are focused primarily on design, investigation, remediation, and removal of radiological, hazardous, and toxic wastes from soils, structures, and groundwater for federal, state, tribal, and local governments and private industry clients.  

  

  

  

**POSITION PURPOSE:**  

This position shall provide support for our environmental investigation, remediation, site surveillance, maintenance, and facility support project for the Department of Energy in Ventura County, California. Primary responsibilities will be to support environmental investigations, air/groundwater sampling, monitoring, remediation, surveillance/maintenance and inspection, and daily operations. We are seeking a candidate with experience with a variety of soil/groundwater/air sampling techniques, drilling oversight, and environmental investigations/remedial actions.  

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Groundwater, soil, and air sampling and monitoring data collection.
* Field duties will include drilling oversight of investigative and remedial projects.
* Technical oversight of drilling, sampling, and onsite subcontractors.
* Oversight of heavy equipment, construction, and demolition subcontractors.
* Serve as onsite safety for the project team and all subcontractors.
* Ability to provide a safe working environment for all onsite workers. Health and safety must be implemented in every aspect of the job duties, with the ability to recognize and mitigate hazards.
* Surveillance, maintenance, and inspection of DOE\-owned monitoring wells and infrastructure on a weekly basis.
* Calibrate and use instrumentation for environmental and health and safety data collection.
* Perform operation and maintenance on groundwater extraction/treatment systems and extraction of groundwater within subsurface structures to maintain safe access.
* Ensure the site is maintained and in safe condition for all project stakeholders and site visitors.
* Able to directly interface with client and stakeholder personnel for project site tours and/or investigate and report site conditions when requested.
* Provide site orientation and safety training to all onsite personnel and new project team members upon request.
* Data analysis and field summary report writing.
* Preparation of data tables and technical reporting tasks.
* Manage all field geological aspects of environmental projects.
* Responsible for management of project recording keeping such as daily reports, site accountability, environmental data, inspection forms, waste logs, profiles, and manifests, etc.
* Organize, lead project teams and participate in field efforts as needed to support the successful execution of projects.
* Analyze project needs and establish appropriate project priorities.
* Analyze and evaluate technical environmental data to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Assisting in developing more junior staff in technical and consulting excellence.


**ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Collect data and samples in accordance with approved procedures.
* Able to proficiently use Microsoft office tools, software, and applications.
* Participate in client stakeholder meetings and public relations.
* Provide field status updates in client meetings.
* Experience with Waste Management, staging, and disposal


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

**Education and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor's Degree in geology, engineering, or environmental science
* Must have a minimum of 5 years of related experience in the environmental field.
* 3\+ years of experience with soil, groundwater and air sampling.
* Knowledge and experience with various media (e.g., soil, groundwater, air), contaminant types, and standard operating procedures for investigation and corrective action.
* Demonstrated experience writing technical plans and reports for regulatory review.
* Knowledge and experience with drilling oversight including soil borings, monitoring well installations, and monitoring well abandonments.

**Skills and Abilities:**  



* Ability to manage field projects with extensive customer contact.
* Able to manage field subcontractors.
* Excellent interpersonal skills; work effectively and cooperatively with all levels of management, staff, and clients, as well as outside business associates.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; ability to effectively present information and respond effectively and sensitively to questions from clients, managers, staff and the general public.
* Ability to utilize multiple word\-processing and database applications including MS Office applications for SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and Access.
* Demonstrate the ability to work accurately, follow procedures and schedules, and prioritize multiple tasks.
* Excellent proof\-reading and writing skills.
* High degree of sensitivity regarding confidential client information.
* Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team, and make decisions, solve problems, exercise sound judgment, work under pressure, and capable of prioritizing workload.


**Special Requirements:**  



* Must pass pre\-employment background check.
* Must pass pre\-employment drug testing.
* Must have a valid dr

jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
At Stantec, we help deliver the critical minerals needed to power our world, from the cars we drive to the infrastructure powering our communities. And we don’t just design the largest, deepest, and most technically challenging mines in the world—we do it sustainably. We’re helping clients reduce energy usage, adopt clean energy sources, and implement digital solutions and automation.


Join our team of mining professionals and you’ll be at the forefront of this evolving industry while building the mine of the future. You’ll also build your own future, with exciting opportunities for development and advancement.


Your Opportunity


Stantec is seeking dynamic and creative candidates to join our growing Geosciences Team as a Senior Hydrogeologist. The Senior Hydrogeologist will take a technical lead role and execute unsaturated and saturated flow modeling and related projects for mining studies/projects of varying size and complexity, and at various project stages from initial concepts through execution. This person may be required to work on several projects at a time. We support clients in all phases of the mining life cycle, from exploration through post\-closure.


The Senior Hydrogeologist will join a team of about 20 hydrogeologists and geochemists across our western regional offices. This position will require a passionate and organized individual who can interface and develop relationships with our mining clients; develop and lead teams; develop project scopes, budgets, and schedules; develop and lead site investigations and characterization; execute and review calculations; construct and simulate saturated and unsaturated flow models; and prepare expertly written reports. This individual will interact throughout the organization internally and externally with clients and members of business and professional organizations.


Your Key Responsibilities


* Work with hydrogeologists, geochemists, and geotechnical engineers, to develop conceptual site models, develop analytical and numerical models of unsaturated and saturated groundwater flow, and design evapotranspiration cover systems.
* Develop mine water management approaches including water budgets, mine dewatering, waste material impoundments, and groundwater containment/mitigation.
* Work with clients to deliver safe, responsible, and innovative solutions.
* Attend meetings and interface with clients, agencies, external consultants, contractors, sub\-contractors, and/or vendors.
* Conduct quality assurance and quality control on their own projects and projects of peers.
* Prepare technical reports.
* Support business development efforts and proposal preparation.
* Contribute to an innovative and collaborative work environment where creativity is valued and encouraged.
* Supervise and mentor junior staff members and support hiring new talents.
* International or national travel can be expected.

Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Expertise in unsaturated flow modeling using HYDRUS or SVFlux is essential.
* Expertise in saturated flow modeling using MODFLOW and/or FEFLOW.
* Strong expertise in evapotranspiration cover design.
* Ability to lead evapotranspiration cover design projects.
* Experience in marketing and preparing proposals and presentations.
* Ability to mentor junior to mid\-level staff.
* Strong technical report writing skills.
* Ability to work on several projects or tasks during any given day on a consistent basis.
* Ability to manage time, be organized, and set priorities.
* Possess strong problem\-solving skills and ability to make timely decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to perform in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* Be a driver of a positive work environment.
* Valid driver’s license.

Education and Experience


* Minimum of an M.S. in Hydrogeology/Geology/Geochemistry or related field is preferred.
* A minimum of 10 years of working experience in consulting or regulatory environment, regularly developing or utilizing unsaturated and saturated flow models is preferred.
* Existing professional registration or ability to work towards a professional registration (PG or PE).

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.


Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other's talents, do exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us. At Stantec, we live our corporate values every day. Join us and redefine your personal best. Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other’s talents, contribute to exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us in a measurable way. Join us and redefine your personal best. \#EnergyAcceleration

* Locations in CO, HI, IL, MD \& Various CA, NJ, VA Areas\-$96,600\.00 \- $144,900\.00 Annually


**Pay Transparency:** In compliance with pay transparency laws, pay ranges are provided for positions in locations where required. Please note, the final agreed upon compensation is based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. At Stantec certain roles are bonus eligible. Actual compensation for part\-time roles will be pro\-rated based on the agreed number of working hours per week.


**Benefits Summary:** Regular full\-time and part\-time employees (working at least 20 hours per week) have access to medical, dental, and vision plans, a wellness program, health saving accounts, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase program, life and accidental death \& dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance, short\-term/long\-term disability plans, emergency travel benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional membership fee coverage and paid family leave. jobs.title: Palantir Foundry Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Palantir Foundry Data Analyst**  

We need an experienced Palantir Foundry Data Analyst at the National Guard Bureau (NGB). The NGB is the link between the Army and Air National Guard and the Department of War (DoW). You will support operations on the Minuteman project team, which manages the NGB's enterprise data environment within the DoW's central analytics platform, and solves real\-world problems through app development, geospatial analysis, and data summarization directly enabling smarter, faster decision\-making for end users. In this role, you will build within Palantir Foundry applications including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia to streamline workflows, create dynamic apps, map geospatial data, and summarize insights, translating complex requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use applications while working with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful products. This is a full\-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.
  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES*** Build and deliver applications within Palantir Foundry using Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Analyze, explore, clean, and visualize complex mission datasets to produce actionable insights
* Develop maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry to support operational analysis
* Apply data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) capabilities, to surface insights quickly
* Translate complex mission requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use Foundry applications
* Work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights
* Apply data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design principles so findings are clear and usable
* Research, design, and develop software and specialized utility programs in support of mission requirements
* Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis
* Update and enhance existing software capabilities
* Develop specifications and performance requirements, coordinating with engineering counterparts to integrate hardware and software systems as required
* Maintain databases within the application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team
* Streamline workflows and support DoW operations on the Minuteman project team to enable faster, better\-informed decisions

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Three (3\) to ten (10\) years of directly related experience
* 3\+ years of experience with data analysis, exploration, visualization, or cleaning
* 3\+ years of experience building within Palantir Foundry applications, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Experience with data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) tools
* Experience building maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry
* Experience with data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design
* Ability to translate complex requirements into efficient workflows or easy\-to\-use applications in Foundry
* Ability to work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience with the Department of War (DoW) mission and associated datasets
* Experience with Advana, Databricks, Power BI, Qlik, or Tableau in a DoD environment
* Prior experience supporting OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R) or National Guard Bureau (NGB) missions

  

**EDUCATION*** B.A./B.S. or M.A./M.S. in Data Analytics, Information Systems, or Business Intelligence

  

**LOCATION*** National Capital Region. One day onsite in Arlington, VA – Preferred
* Fully remote \- Acceptable

  

**CLEARANCE*** Active Secret security clearance
* U.S. citizenship is required since this role supports the U.S. Federal government

  

**CLIENT*** OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R), Minuteman project team

  

**WORK HOURS*** 40 hours per week. 8 hours per day

  

**EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION*** Employment Classification Eligibility — W2

  

**COMPENSATION*** Salary range: $155,000 \- $165,000
* Benefits: Benefits package includes options for health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401k contribution options

***West 4th Strategy is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, age, marital status, mental disability, physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy, political affiliation, military or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by federal or state law.***  

  

**Other Considerations:** *applicants will be subject to a background investigation. Individual’s primary workstation is located in an office area. The noise level in this environment is low to moderate. Regularly required to sit for extended periods up to 80% of the time; frequently required to move about to access file cabinets and use office equipment such as PC, copier, fax, telephone, cell phone, etc. Occasionally required to reach overhead, bend, and lift objects of up to 10 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include the use of computer monitor screens up to 80% of the time.*

At Stantec, we help deliver the critical minerals needed to power our world, from the cars we drive to the infrastructure powering our communities. And we don’t just design the largest, deepest, and most technically challenging mines in the world—we do it sustainably. We’re helping clients reduce energy usage, adopt clean energy sources, and implement digital solutions and automation.


Join our team of mining professionals and you’ll be at the forefront of this evolving industry while building the mine of the future. You’ll also build your own future, with exciting opportunities for development and advancement.


Your Opportunity


Stantec is seeking dynamic and creative candidates to join our growing Geosciences Team as a Senior Hydrogeologist. The Senior Hydrogeologist will take a technical lead role and execute unsaturated and saturated flow modeling and related projects for mining studies/projects of varying size and complexity, and at various project stages from initial concepts through execution. This person may be required to work on several projects at a time. We support clients in all phases of the mining life cycle, from exploration through post\-closure.


The Senior Hydrogeologist will join a team of about 20 hydrogeologists and geochemists across our western regional offices. This position will require a passionate and organized individual who can interface and develop relationships with our mining clients; develop and lead teams; develop project scopes, budgets, and schedules; develop and lead site investigations and characterization; execute and review calculations; construct and simulate saturated and unsaturated flow models; and prepare expertly written reports. This individual will interact throughout the organization internally and externally with clients and members of business and professional organizations.


Your Key Responsibilities


* Work with hydrogeologists, geochemists, and geotechnical engineers, to develop conceptual site models, develop analytical and numerical models of unsaturated and saturated groundwater flow, and design evapotranspiration cover systems.
* Develop mine water management approaches including water budgets, mine dewatering, waste material impoundments, and groundwater containment/mitigation.
* Work with clients to deliver safe, responsible, and innovative solutions.
* Attend meetings and interface with clients, agencies, external consultants, contractors, sub\-contractors, and/or vendors.
* Conduct quality assurance and quality control on their own projects and projects of peers.
* Prepare technical reports.
* Support business development efforts and proposal preparation.
* Contribute to an innovative and collaborative work environment where creativity is valued and encouraged.
* Supervise and mentor junior staff members and support hiring new talents.
* International or national travel can be expected.

Your Capabilities and Credentials


* Expertise in unsaturated flow modeling using HYDRUS or SVFlux is essential.
* Expertise in saturated flow modeling using MODFLOW and/or FEFLOW.
* Strong expertise in evapotranspiration cover design.
* Ability to lead evapotranspiration cover design projects.
* Experience in marketing and preparing proposals and presentations.
* Ability to mentor junior to mid\-level staff.
* Strong technical report writing skills.
* Ability to work on several projects or tasks during any given day on a consistent basis.
* Ability to manage time, be organized, and set priorities.
* Possess strong problem\-solving skills and ability to make timely decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to perform in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* Be a driver of a positive work environment.
* Valid driver’s license.

Education and Experience


* Minimum of an M.S. in Hydrogeology/Geology/Geochemistry or related field is preferred.
* A minimum of 10 years of working experience in consulting or regulatory environment, regularly developing or utilizing unsaturated and saturated flow models is preferred.
* Existing professional registration or ability to work towards a professional registration (PG or PE).

new_jobs.title: Palantir Foundry Data Analyst

**Palantir Foundry Data Analyst**  

We need an experienced Palantir Foundry Data Analyst at the National Guard Bureau (NGB). The NGB is the link between the Army and Air National Guard and the Department of War (DoW). You will support operations on the Minuteman project team, which manages the NGB's enterprise data environment within the DoW's central analytics platform, and solves real\-world problems through app development, geospatial analysis, and data summarization directly enabling smarter, faster decision\-making for end users. In this role, you will build within Palantir Foundry applications including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia to streamline workflows, create dynamic apps, map geospatial data, and summarize insights, translating complex requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use applications while working with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful products. This is a full\-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.
  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES*** Build and deliver applications within Palantir Foundry using Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Analyze, explore, clean, and visualize complex mission datasets to produce actionable insights
* Develop maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry to support operational analysis
* Apply data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) capabilities, to surface insights quickly
* Translate complex mission requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use Foundry applications
* Work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights
* Apply data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design principles so findings are clear and usable
* Research, design, and develop software and specialized utility programs in support of mission requirements
* Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis
* Update and enhance existing software capabilities
* Develop specifications and performance requirements, coordinating with engineering counterparts to integrate hardware and software systems as required
* Maintain databases within the application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team
* Streamline workflows and support DoW operations on the Minuteman project team to enable faster, better\-informed decisions

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Three (3\) to ten (10\) years of directly related experience
* 3\+ years of experience with data analysis, exploration, visualization, or cleaning
* 3\+ years of experience building within Palantir Foundry applications, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Experience with data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) tools
* Experience building maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry
* Experience with data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design
* Ability to translate complex requirements into efficient workflows or easy\-to\-use applications in Foundry
* Ability to work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience with the Department of War (DoW) mission and associated datasets
* Experience with Advana, Databricks, Power BI, Qlik, or Tableau in a DoD environment
* Prior experience supporting OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R) or National Guard Bureau (NGB) missions

  

**EDUCATION*** B.A./B.S. or M.A./M.S. in Data Analytics, Information Systems, or Business Intelligence

  

**LOCATION*** National Capital Region. One day onsite in Arlington, VA – Preferred
* Fully remote \- Acceptable

  

**CLEARANCE*** Active Secret security clearance
* U.S. citizenship is required since this role supports the U.S. Federal government

  

**CLIENT*** OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R), Minuteman project team
